description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller named 'ProfesorController' that manages CRUD operations and views related to 'Profesor' entities in a web application. It includes mappings for adding, editing, updating, listing, and deleting profesores, as well as viewing details.

classes.name: ProfesorController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller handling CRUD and view operations for 'Profesor' entities, secured with role-based access control.

methods.name: addProfesor
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display a form for adding a new profesor.

methods.name: saveProfesor
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save a new profesor via the profesorService.

methods.name: getProfesorForUpdate
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch and display a profesor for editing, based on ID.

methods.name: updateProfesor
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update an existing profesor's details.

methods.name: patchProfesor
methods.description: Handles PATCH-like requests to partially update a profesor's information.

methods.name: getProfesoresList
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all profesores.

methods.name: deleteProfesor
methods.description: Handles GET requests to delete a profesor by ID.

methods.name: getProfesorDetail
methods.description: Handles GET requests to view detailed information about a specific profesor, including their courses.
